environment_variables_audit.rationale: Locally 3000; assigned by orchestrator/ingress in staging and prod
Drives logging verbosity, optimization flags, and error stack trace exposure
Local container vs staging replica vs multi-AZ production primary
Local loopback vs isolated managed cache instances
Verbose debug logs locally vs structured info/error in production
Cryptographic separation ensures compromised dev keys cannot forge prod tokens

micro_exercise.first_run_experience: Without startup schema validation, missing environment variables cause silent downstream failures (e.g. database connection refused or unhandled undefined reference). With strict startup schema validation (Zod/Twelve-Factor), the process crashes immediately at line 1 of boot with a clear enumeration of missing variables and pointers to .env.example.
